title: Switching trace from decision tree depth
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates, let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction, and let $k \in \mathbb{N}$. If the decision-tree depth of the restriction of the Boolean function represented by $\varphi$ under $\rho$ is at least $k+1$, then there exists a switching trace for $\varphi$ relative to $\rho$ of parameter $k+1$.
hypotheses_covered: The formula is a DNF on $n$ coordinates
The decision-tree depth is at least $k+1$
